description: The agent must: (1) Output the trigger phrase '正在触发 openclaw-behavior-plan skill'. (2) Produce a Markdown file named incident_response_plan.md using the exact proprietary template structure: top-level '# 行为计划：...' title, followed by ## 目标, ## 前置条件, ## 执行步骤, ## 异常与回退, and ## 完成标准 sections. (3) Define at least 4 numbered steps under ## 执行步骤, each using exactly the sub-bullets **目的**, **工具/技能**, **输入**, and **预期输出**. (4) Use only approved tool names from the enumerated list (execute_shell, read_file, write_file, search_web), specifically using read_file or execute_shell for log scanning and write_file for the report. (5) Express inter-step data dependencies using the exact notation '依赖步骤 N 的 [output]'. (6) List preconditions using '- [ ]' checkbox syntax. (7) Write fallback rules in the 异常与回退 section using the '若 [condition] → [action]' conditional pattern. (8) List completion criteria using '- [ ]' checkbox syntax. (9) Ensure content is task-specific: covers log scanning for ERROR entries, writing to remediation_report.md, and posting to Slack.
